title: palhinhaea pendulina
intro: Palhinhaea pendulina, commonly known as the fern tree or pendulous polypody, is a species of fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Palhinhaea pendulina include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of digestive issues, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, there is limited scientific research available on this plant, and further studies are necessary to confirm its effectiveness and potential side effects.
